column2: command run in the clone with STOVE, OUT and REBUILD set (output into $OUT). Repos with package/build-amiga.sh or build-amiga.sh need no line.

column1: # Ports built by amiga/Makefile.amigaos (their STOVE defaults to the old open6 path, so the stove goes on make's line)
# Their own Cradle entry points or build scripts

column2: sh guest/network/acnet/build.sh build/opensocket && sh tools/actcptools/build.sh build/opensocket && cp -R build/opensocket "$OUT/"

column1: # The open9 rebuild's no-recipe repos (GF-109, 24 Nov 2026)
# amicradle-guest at acfind-1.4: that tag is ACFind 1.4, built with GFOpenIndex by tools/openindex/build-amiga.sh (beside itself)

column2: sh tools/openindex/build-amiga.sh && mkdir -p "$OUT/GFOpenIndex" && cp tools/openindex/GFOpenIndex tools/openindex/ACFind "$OUT/GFOpenIndex/"

column1: # event.library and EVTest, as release.yml builds them (library/build.sh OUT_DIR)
# gfopenprefs at GFOpenBlanker-1.6-rc1: the tag is the Blanker's; Blanker/build-amiga.sh is its stove_build entry point
# Tata and Tata-Prefs: build.sh needs a checkout of gfopengadtools (OGT) for the prefs window
# GFOS Sans, Sans Bold and Mono (11, 13, 16 px) as FONTS: files, by tools/amigafont.py (no compiler: the fonts are data hunks)

column2: for f in sans:GFOSSans sans-bold:GFOSSansBold mono:GFOSMono; do k=${f%%:*}; n=${f#*:}; mkdir -p "$OUT/Fonts/$n" && python3 tools/amigafont.py build src/gfos-$k-13.txt $n "$OUT/Fonts" src/gfos-$k-11.txt src/gfos-$k-16.txt || exit 1; done
